literal: Clothing and food if they see, upon others fault to find capable will become the base person.
translation: If a base person sees others enjoying decent clothing and food, they will immediately find faults in them out of sheer envy.
modern: பிறர் நல்ல ஆடை உடுத்துவதையும் நல்ல உணவு உண்பதையும் கண்டால், அவர்கள் மீது குற்றம் கண்டுபிடிக்க வல்லவர் ஆவர் கீழ்மைக் குணம் உடையவர்.
explanation: This couplet describes the deep-seated envy of base individuals (கீழ்). When they observe others enjoying basic comforts like clothing (உடுப்பது) and food (உண்பது), they cannot tolerate their prosperity. Driven by jealousy, they actively seek out faults or blemishes (வடு) in them. The word 'வற்று' denotes capability, showing that the only skill a low-minded person possesses is finding flaws in those who are doing well.
